items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Lee was playing with Lorenzo Flennoy... I started subbing for Lee playing the show... I was working with Lorenzo Flennoy at that time... when I was with Lorenzo Flennoy

ctx.x: Stay in school. He told me to stay in school, you know, and that was cool. So in the meantime, Lee was playing with Lorenzo Flennoy and they were playing at the Club Alabam, which was the number one club there, which was equivalent to the Cotton Club here in New York. They had a line of girls, chorus line, singers, dancers, and entertainers, you know, comedians, and I started subbing for Lee playing the show. In the meantime our band that we used to have, we took a gig at the Follies and Buddy, myself, Jack,…
Sing that pattern, the kick pattern for the strippers.
